notes.title: Release Version Uploaded
notes.notes:
Today I am proud to announce that the Early Access Release Build Version has been uploaded to the live branch. This update includes fixes and optimizations. The introduction of explosive weapons for all races. Tweeks and updates to the individual maps for balance and a smooth experience. 

I would like to thank everyone who supported me in the process to make it to this point. There's So much more I want to add to the content as this game evolves. I look forward to the Steam Community's feedback and using that to continue to build upon this foundation. 


-Magus
The Developer
MagiSoftWorks
